kpis.name: S&P 500
kpis.note: Broad equity risk-on/risk-off signal. High VIX or S&P drawdown signals demand risk for Southwire construction end markets.

kpis.name: Brent Crude
kpis.note: Energy costs affect Southwire manufacturing and logistics. Sustained Brent >$90 pressures freight and resin input costs.

kpis.name: Copper (LME)
kpis.note: Primary raw material. Copper content of wire drives COGS. Sustained elevation compresses margin unless hedged or repriced.

kpis.name: Aluminum (LME)
kpis.note: Key input for aluminum wire and cable. Price signals secondary cost pressure and hedge calendar triggers.

kpis.name: Freight (Drewry WCI)
kpis.note: Ocean freight index drives import costs on raw materials and packaging. WCI >$4K signals elevated supply chain risk.
kpis.change: Monitor Drewry WCI weekly for rate momentum

kpis.name: VIX
kpis.note: Equity market fear gauge. VIX >25 indicates risk-off environment; monitor customer demand signals and receivables.

kpis.name: Natural Gas
kpis.note: Energy input for manufacturing and logistics. Sustained elevation pressures margin. Drives residential heating demand indirectly.

kpis.name: Gold
kpis.note: Risk sentiment indicator. Gold >$3,000 with VIX elevation signals macro uncertainty that may dampen CapEx spending by customers.

wire.title: The 'cockroach' in the machine: How Gen Z is rattling South Asia's elites
wire.summary: South Asia's leaders have long boasted about their demographic dividend. But the region's young people are turning it into a political reckoning.

wire.title: 3 dead in mass shooting in Seattle. And, U.S. and Iran pause fighting
wire.summary: A mass shooting at a Seattle festival has left three people dead. And, the U.S. and Iran have been exchanging diplomatic messages after nearly tw weeks of intense fighting.

wire.title: France continues to fight devastating wildfires, while progress is made in Spain
wire.summary: In southern France, a wildfire in the region of Gironde is still active, while two major fires in central Spain are finally coming under control, ahead of the fourth heat wave of the summer.

wire.title: In Memphis, an 'anti-crime' task force quietly turned into an ICE crackdown
wire.summary: The influx of federal agents into the city last fall led to widespread immigration arrests – a majority without criminal convictions. President Trump has said he wants to replicate it elsewhere.

wire.title: Kalshi attacks a Wisconsin law banning election bets as 'voter suppression'
wire.summary: The spat between the leading prediction market company and a key battleground state could be a glimpse into the next major fight between states and the fast-growing industry.

wire.title: Baltimore will turn 911 into more than just an emergency number
wire.summary: Baltimore is rethinking what it means to call 911, and who responds. Callers who don't need police will get help finding social services and healthcare before they actually fall into crisis.

wire.title: Morning news brief
wire.summary: Three people were killed in a shooting at a Seattle food festival Sunday, U.S and Iran pause airstrikes, with less than 100 days left until Election Day, a look at how the midterms are shaping up.

wire.title: Can the U.S. and Iran take the off-ramp?
wire.summary: The U.S. military has paused its airstrikes on Iran after nearly two weeks of intensifying bombing, while diplomatic efforts have pushed forward to try to avert a return to all-out war.

wire.title: With just a few primary elections to go, the competitive Senate map keeps shifting
wire.summary: For Democrats to take control of the U.S. Senate, they have to flip four seats currently held by Republicans. Republicans, meanwhile, are playing defense and pickup opportunities are harder to find.

wire.title: Tadej Pogačar of Slovenia wins the 2026 Tour de France, his fifth victory in the race
wire.summary: The route for the iconic cycling race's final stage was shortened because security and police were reassigned to assist with wildfires in southwest France.

wire.title: Devastating European wildfires in maps - and how they're being tackled
wire.summary: A blaze near Bordeaux has torn through more than 162 sq miles (420 sq km) in less than four days, while the Madrid region is seeing its worst fires ever.

wire.title: Ukraine dismisses Iranian threats as Caspian Sea strike directly links wars
wire.summary: Iran has reacted with fury to the assault on the vessel, with Tehran's foreign minister saying it "cannot go unanswered".

wire.title: More than 600 US military service members injured since Iran War began in February
wire.summary: The latest figure includes casualties from Operation Fury and a new category called "Overseas Operations".

wire.title: Anger as Berlin Pride attacker revealed to have been freed weeks earlier
wire.summary: As details emerge about the suspected Berlin Pride attacker's past, many are asking why he was not in prison.

wire.title: Shots fired at US consulate in Toronto for a second time this year
wire.summary: Police said they engaged in a high-speed car chase but failed to arrest the suspect, who remains at large. Three people were arrested in June after a similar attack.

wire.title: Carly Simon reveals Parkinson's diagnosis
wire.summary: The singer also reveals she has received treatment for skin cancer, but vows to keep singing.
